_comment: ComputeEnergy — a third worked domain template, alongside climate.json and nutrition.json, and the one used by docs/demo-compute-energy.md as the standard first demo. Chosen because its characteristic failure is not disagreement about values but a NUMBER THAT HAS OUTRUN ITS METHODOLOGY: a figure gets quoted at a boundary it was never measured at, or cited to a source that never contained it. That failure is legible to a physicist, a utility engineer, a proof-of-work miner, and someone reading their electricity bill, which is why it demos across audiences that share no other vocabulary.
description: Claims about the electricity, water, and grid impact of computation — AI training and inference, datacenter siting, and proof-of-work — where the dominant failure mode is a real measurement quoted outside the boundary it was taken at. Stating the measurement boundary and tracing a figure to its primary source are first-class epistemic norms here, not background assumptions.

critique_species.name: BoundaryCritique
required_evidence: A statement of what the disputed figure actually measures: which stage (training or inference), which enclosure (chip, rack, or whole facility), and over what unit of work

critique_species.name: TrainingVsInferenceCritique
required_evidence: Which stage the cited measurement covers, and the figure for the other stage where the claim treats them as one number

critique_species.name: ChipVsFacilityCritique
required_evidence: The PUE applied, or an explicit statement that the figure excludes cooling and facility overhead

critique_species.name: MarginalVsAverageCritique
required_evidence: The grid emissions or capacity factor used, and whether it is an average or a marginal/consequential factor

critique_species.name: ProvenanceCritique
required_evidence: The chain of citation from the claim back to a primary measurement, or the specific link at which that chain breaks

critique_species.name: CitationLaunderingCritique
required_evidence: The primary source, quoted, showing it does not contain the figure attributed to it

critique_species.name: StaleBaselineCritique
required_evidence: The date and hardware generation of the underlying measurement, and a current figure for the same quantity where one exists

critique_species.name: LocalIncidenceCritique
required_evidence: The specific facility, ratepayer class, watershed, or airshed where the cost lands, and how it differs from the aggregate figure being quoted

critique_species.name: RatepayerIncidenceCritique
required_evidence: The tariff, rate case, or interconnection agreement that determines who actually pays for the new load

critique_species.name: ReboundCritique
required_evidence: The efficiency gain being claimed, and the total-consumption series over the same period
